# Cloudflare Workers Free candidate — 2026-09-26

**Disposition:** provisional interface candidate, not a qualified default or production release. A dedicated Cloudflare token exists; one small JSON case passed, and the frozen synthetic tool case failed at its closing answer.

The owner’s existing Cloudflare account was already signed in. The dashboard showed **Workers Free** active and a separate **R2 Paid** subscription. R2 is outside the campaign. After specific action-time approval, a 30-day account token named `Co-Scientist free campaign` was created with only Workers AI Read and Write. The account list showed that exact scope, and the token verification API returned HTTP 200, `active`, with expiry 2026-10-26 23:59:59 UTC. Its value is held only in an owner-readable local file outside the repository; the file is mode 600. Do not use the R2 token or broaden the campaign token's scope.

[Cloudflare pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) gives Workers Free 10,000 Neurons per day at no charge and says over-limit operations fail. Usage above that allocation requires Workers Paid; merely having a separate R2 Paid subscription does not establish a Workers Paid plan. The listed [`@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it` model](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/%40cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it/) has 256,000-token context, function calling and streaming. It is not in Cloudflare’s [documented JSON Mode model list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/features/json-mode/), so the project’s JSON boundary is an empirical question. [Cloudflare’s data-use policy](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/) says Workers AI content is not used to train models or improve services or shared with other customers; it is not a blanket zero-retention guarantee.

The test-first provisional guard admits only the exact Gemma model, an account-pinned OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an operator attestation bound to the current UTC date and Workers Free plan, and a dedicated token. It excludes SDK fallback/alias routing, paid-model substitution, server tools and unrecognized options. It sends `options.rejectIfBusy: true` to fail fast under capacity pressure. It accepts only the engine’s bounded `json_object` and `json_schema` request shapes for **qualification**, without claiming the provider supports either. It forces LiteLLM’s `drop_params` off so an unsupported JSON parameter produces an observable error instead of silently becoming a prompt-only response. A 4,096-token output cap limits exploratory requests and deliberately rejects the engine’s 24,000-token output case. The attestation is an assertion, not an automated plan or quota readback; it is unsuitable as an unattended production control without further design.

The public `call_llm` and `call_llm_json` boundaries were exercised with mocked transport, including streaming/tool arguments, both JSON request formats and a real project schema envelope with `strict: false`. The first red test reproduced the original OpenRouter-only rejection; a subsequent red test showed the JSON call could not reach the provider until the guard admitted its exact shape. Final focused engine tests: 102 passed; adjacent app free-request tests: 23 passed; Ruff, mypy and `git diff --check` passed. One later JSON request passed and the tool round trip failed; scientific quality, invoice-level billing and full-run suitability remain unverified. M11-OPS-02c and its dependent items stay open.

## Bounded qualification sequence

The [model page](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/%40cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it/) lists `response_format` and `max_completion_tokens` in a generic API schema, without a model-specific guarantee for JSON compliance or a 24,000-token output ceiling. Before any call, recheck Workers Free, remaining daily Neurons, model eligibility, data use and exact token scope; pin the code and fixed public-input hashes. Then use one exact configuration through the project interfaces, with no paid fallback or retries: first one `call_llm_json` schema case, then only on success a tool round trip capped at two physical requests, one streaming case, and one long-input/output-budget case after a test-first adjustment to the provisional 4,096-token guard. Stop at the first timeout, rate limit, unsupported parameter, missing served-model/usage receipt or wrong route. Do not repeat an unresponsive case. Only if every interface case passes should the retained four-claim batch gate run, stopping on the first completed wrong-label trial and requiring three passing fresh trials before broader selection. A pass here would still require the rest of M11-OPS-02c's full-run, privacy, zero-spend and release evidence. The token creation and bounded public-input trial are authorized; this procedure does not establish model qualification or an unattended production configuration.

The [official error table](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/errors/) distinguishes Free allocation exhaustion (`3036`, HTTP 429), temporary capacity (`3040`, HTTP 429, including `rejectIfBusy`), and a model that requires Workers Paid (`5035`, HTTP 403). Retain the exact provider code. A `3036` is a quota stop until the next 00:00 UTC reset, `3040` fails the present route reliability check without repeated probes, and `5035` disqualifies the model under zero additional spending. No paid-plan upgrade or alternative billing path is authorized.

On 26 September, the signed-in subscription table again showed **Workers Free — Active**; R2 Paid remained a separate subscription. The Workers AI dashboard route opened its onboarding page and exposed no Neurons meter. A current-day remaining balance therefore cannot be claimed from the dashboard. For one public-input probe, the verified Free plan and Cloudflare's documented hard failure above 10,000 Neurons provide the zero-charge boundary even if the daily balance is not visible: an exhausted or busy call stops qualification, and no paid plan, gateway credits, fallback or retry is used. This is not an unattended plan/usage verification design.

The first case is frozen in [`cloudflare-json-probe-prereg-v1.json`](cloudflare-json-probe-prereg-v1.json). It pins the exact candidate, public prompt and schema, sixteen source hashes, one application attempt, one physical call, no SDK retry, disabled cache/thinking, 45-second timeout, and a verbatim support criterion. [`probe_cloudflare_json.py`](probe_cloudflare_json.py) requires the preregistration digest and current-day Free attestation before transport, records the wire response format and served model, and writes a sanitized exclusive artifact. This is an interface screen only; the app's four-claim batch gate, 24,000-token calls, privacy equivalence and unattended production control remain unqualified.

The [one-call result](cloudflare-gemma-json-2026-09-26.json) passed the frozen criterion under preregistration SHA-256 `66d0dcf8bdf4e98f6dc5d935f2937bee91ae99453fd4bec28237b27ccf3dd16b`. Exactly one provider request completed in 4.6 seconds with served model `@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it`, 340 prompt and 240 completion tokens, `finish_reason=stop`, `rejectIfBusy=true`, and SDK retries forced to zero. The raw provider JSON, before the engine's default-field repair, explicitly returned `supports` and a verbatim quote; the parsed result agreed. The engine sent `json_object` after its normal `json_schema` downgrade, so this is **application JSON-path compatibility for one small public case**, not native schema support. Artifact SHA-256: `a55200895a7cea761be4c9d3f982a810a661b1309605ce9513b037fffd941e36`. The signed-in subscription still showed Workers Free Active afterward; the Workers AI page still exposed no Neurons meter, and no invoice-level cost readback is claimed.

For an unattended default, the dated operator attestation is still unresolved. Cloudflare's [subscription read API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/accounts/subresources/subscriptions/methods/get/) requires `Billing Read` or `Billing Write`, neither included in the draft Workers AI-only token. Granting either would be a separate security-scope decision; do not assume the current draft can automatically verify Workers Free each day. [AI Gateway ZDR](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/) applies only to Unified Billing with Cloudflare-managed credentials, which requires purchased credits, and does not control gateway logging. [Gateway spend limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/spend-limits/) are estimate-based and eventually consistent, so they cannot prove zero additional spending. Keep direct Workers AI for bounded public-input qualification; do not add a gateway as a privacy or billing workaround.

An independent Antigravity Gemini 3.8 Flash High diff review found a misspelled test environment variable and the original JSON-blocking gap; both were corrected. Its claim that Workers Free automatically bills overage was contradicted by the current Cloudflare pricing page and was not adopted. The review also highlighted the dated attestation and BYOK interaction; campaign mode intentionally overrides BYOK under the existing policy, while explicit BYOK outside campaign mode remains unchanged.

## Tool round-trip result and stop

The separately [frozen tool protocol](cloudflare-c3-tool-prereg-v1.json) (SHA-256 `a7a0d9241ed08692e5419ad9512e905ecf9ac1f2a0315d647ab82de5e051af01`) pins the exact public synthetic tool input, source commit `f7622841`, 21 source hashes, LiteLLM `1.80.17`, both SDK retry knobs at zero, two physical requests maximum, and a literal final sentence. An independent Luna 6 xhigh review found and verified fixes for hidden retries, false-positive answer matching, and dirty-source preregistration. Nineteen adjacent Cloudflare probe tests passed before the live call.

The [one tool trial](cloudflare-c3-tool-2026-09-26.json) (SHA-256 `178d8a692cd5a449b483f12b1918de209dec78f10ebe2b3a8df6cf8025b9dd32`) used exactly two requests through `call_llm_with_tools` in 20.7 seconds. The first returned the pinned model, positive usage (135 prompt/398 completion tokens), and exactly the requested `lookup_public_measurement(control-A)` call; the local tool returned the fixed 137 arbitrary units. The closing request returned the same model and positive usage (214 prompt/1,024 completion tokens), but `finish_reason=length` and no accepted final answer. The frozen configuration therefore fails tool round-trip compatibility. No retry, fallback, larger-budget substitution, streaming case, long-input case, or four-claim scientific trial followed. The artifact contains neither the token nor raw account ID. Workers Free still showed Active after the trial, but no invoice-level cost receipt is claimed.

**Disposition:** not qualified for a default. The successful first tool turn makes a larger output allowance a plausible, untested *new configuration*, not a pass for this frozen one. It remains inconclusive whether Gemma can finish the full tool loop or meet the scientific, privacy and unattended zero-spend gates. This result does not authorize an immediate repeat; any later trial needs a distinct preregistered reason and controls. Production roles and users' BYOK behavior remain unchanged.

A fresh read-only policy audit on 26 September found no shortcut through the same account. [Workers AI pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) confirms that the Free plan's 10,000-Neuron allocation is uncharged and fails closed on exhaustion; the model's listed token price does not itself make Workers Paid safe for this campaign. The [data-use policy](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/data-usage/) rules out training, service improvement and sharing with other customers, but does not promise zero retention for direct inference. The documented [AI Gateway ZDR option](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/) belongs to Unified Billing with purchased credits, outside the zero-additional-spending boundary. The existing Workers AI-only token cannot read the account's plan; [subscription readback](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/accounts/subresources/subscriptions/methods/get/) requires Billing Read. Therefore a larger-budget tool trial would still leave privacy and unattended plan-state admission unresolved. Resolve those gates before spending further calls on this candidate; do not infer strict ZDR or an automatic plan check from the dated Free-plan screenshot.

**Active-tree cleanup, 27 September:** The unqualified provisional runtime route and one-off JSON/tool probe scripts and tests were removed before an evidence release. Their exact source remains in Git at `2db00ba0` and the frozen protocols and sanitized results remain here. Adjacent OpenRouter free-policy and gateway tests passed 87/87 after removal. No production route or default was changed.
